channel.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) (hpe).

item.title: CVE-2026-76740 · 7.2 HIGH — HPE Compute Scale-up Server 3200 and 3250 platforms, Superdome Flex and Superdome Flex 280 servers, Remote Command Execution vulnerability
item.description: A security vulnerability in HPE Compute Scale-up Server 3200 and 3250 platforms, Superdome Flex and Superdome Flex 280 servers could be exploited remotely to execute arbitrary commands on the RMC.

item.title: CVE-2026-76739 · 4.3 MEDIUM — HPE Compute Scale-up Server 3200 and 3250 platforms and Superdome Flex server, Remote RMC file modification
item.description: A potential security vulnerability in HPE Compute Scale-up Server 3200 and 3250 platforms and Superdome Flex server could be remotely exploited to list and modify RMC filesystem.

item.title: CVE-2026-79843 · 6.5 MEDIUM — HPE NonStop SQL/MX EXE - out-of-bounds read vulnerability
item.description: A corrupted file may cause out-of-bounds read in HPE NonStop SQL/MX EXE under certain conditions, potentially leading to information disclosure, process termination, CPU halt, or data corruption.
